code.text: Pre-encounter clinical records delivery (CDex) — NEMG → Connie → Cornell Scott-Hill dental

focus.display: Timothy Jones pre-encounter medical records (collection bundle)

requester.display: Northeast Medical Group — Pediatrics (Yale New Haven Health)

owner.display: Cornell Scott-Hill Health Center (receiving dental practice)

note.text: CDex-style clinical-data delivery, one week before the 2026-05-28 dental appointment, so Dr. Watson has Timothy's diabetes context, medications, devices, care team, and oral-health findings ahead of the visit — motivated by the accompanying caregiver being a grandparent with limited medical-history knowledge. Records are extracted as discrete FHIR from the NEMG/Yale New Haven Health Epic instance (Care Everywhere) and routed by Connie to the dental practice's interim FHIR server. status 'completed' reflects Connie-confirmed receipt at the dental practice. This is a SEPARATE Task from the referral-tracking Task (Task/task-referral-tracking) — records delivery and referral state are tracked independently. No patient-facing notification fires for this provider-to-provider exchange.
